summary: All checks green and no code bugs found. The data audit's one error (v-20261117-04 behind YouTube) came from YouTube's own counter jumping between two reads, not from a bug. Wrote verdicts for the three 16 Nov Shorts and handed the owner's sound note to the improver.
why: pytest 564, workers 195 tests, tsc and lint all pass. The audit error: the dashboard had 306 views from a live refresh 10 minutes before YouTube showed 342, on a Short gaining about 14 views an hour. Both numbers came from YouTube's public counter, which updates in batches.

findings.title: paisa-panchayat: behind_youtube on v-20261117-04 isn't a bug
findings.detail: Live refresh 14:22:52 UTC read 306; audit at 14:33 read 342. Same source, and applyLiveCounts never lowers a count without confirmation.

findings.title: paisa-panchayat: no per-video sound-effect set exists
findings.detail: Every Short uses the same synthesized pop, whoosh, kaching, boom and tick; the music genre rotates but sits ~89% ducked under the voice. Handed to the improver (owner note cmwk4neu).

findings.title: paisa-panchayat analysis: GTA V hit, Ellison okay, Amazon cloud miss
findings.detail: 588, 185 and 44 views against a 95-view median at 48 h; the Amazon title carries both figures.

findings.title: geography and tech channels: nothing to audit
findings.detail: No published videos yet, so no metrics, no audit issues and no analysis.
